about: Round 1022. The two fact tables in src/lib/soccerCareerEngine.ts that a Soccer Career player sees as real: INT_SCORING_RECORDS (each nation's men's all time international scoring record, which decides the All Time Top Scorer award and its line) and the league label on every one of the 190 HAND_CLUBS rows. Every value here was read on the date beside it from two independent sources that agree, none of them Wikipedia. Where two sources disagreed a third settled it, and where nothing settled it the value is left out (intRecordsHeld): a nation with no verified row gets no award at all, there is no default. scripts/simCareerFacts.mjs holds the engine to this file and fails if either side moves. Records held by active players move with every international window, so each row carries asOf, the last date both sources were read; refresh them together, never one side.

Argentina.note: Active. Farewell match against Benin was scheduled for the evening of 2026-10-06, after this read.

Belgium.note: Active. 94th goal against Turkey in the October 2026 Nations League window.

Brazil.note: Final. Official matches between national teams only, FIFA's count, on which Pele has 77. The CBF's own count, which takes in matches against clubs and select sides, gives Pele 95 in 113 (futemais above), so the line 'Became Brazil's All Time Top International Scorer' holds on FIFA's count. Neymar retired from the national team on 2026-07-29.
